title: The 1918 Circus Train Wreck Near Hammond, and Showmen's Rest

sources.what: 'the engineer of an empty military troop train fell asleep and crashed into a Hagenbeck-Wallace Circus train near here'; 'An estimated eighty-six people died'; 'over 100 others were injured'
around 4 a.m.; an empty train used to transport soldiers; 86 killed; more than 100 injured
stopped about 4 a.m.; engineer fell asleep; 86 perished; graves marked 'unknown male'; stone elephants
'Five days after the crash ... the burial of 56'; most stones 'Unknown Male'; elephants with trunks lowered
June 27, 1918, five days after; trumpeting from the nearby Brookfield Zoo
visitors claim to hear elephants trumpeting; Brookfield Zoo nearby
'you can hear the trumpeting of the elephants' ... real elephants from Brookfield Zoo
Brookfield Zoo's last elephants left in 2010
collision about 3:57 a.m.; caused by the engineman of the troop train being asleep; rear-end collision with the stopped circus train

beats.text: 4 in the morning. A troop train's engineer fell asleep.
beats.label: NEAR HAMMOND, 1918

beats.text: On June 22, 1918, a circus train had stopped on the tracks between Hammond and Gary.
beats.label: JUNE 22, 1918

beats.text: An empty troop train slammed into it from behind.
beats.label: THE CRASH

beats.text: About 86 people died. More than 100 were hurt.
beats.label: ABOUT 86

beats.text: Five days later, dozens of them were buried together outside Chicago, at Showmen's Rest. Most of the graves are marked Unknown.
beats.label: SHOWMEN'S REST
beats.credit: Showmen's League of America · AI-generated picture

beats.text: Stone elephants stand around the graves, trunks lowered. Visitors say they've heard elephants trumpeting there. The nearby zoo hasn't had elephants since 2010.
beats.label: WHAT VISITORS SAY

beats.text: Comment your town for the next La Porte After Dark.

factcheck.result: 'A troop train's engineer' (not the circus train's); stones 'Unknown Male/Female' became 'graves marked Unknown'; the zoo line now says it hasn't had elephants since 2010; dune and lightning removed; map pin moved toward the Hammond-Gary line; all supported
